comments.author: @bbplayer0412
comments.text:
As a Malaysian born who has been living OUTSIDE of Malaysia for more than 16 years already,  even though I am enjoying life in another country, I miss Malaysia more and more as time goes by 😢😭 The longer I live overseas, the more I appreciate that sense of being Malaysian and the whole of Malaysia. We never know the value of what we have, as well as the people with whom we had a special bond with in our lives until they are gone. I really miss the Malaysian lifestyle, food, culture and natural beauty.

I will always be fortunate and grateful to be born in Malaysia 🇲🇾💛💙❤️🤍🥲 You can take the Malaysian out of Malaysia, but can NEVER take Malaysia out of the Malaysian. To all of my relatives, good friends, good teachers, the people with whom I had a special bond with, and all Malaysians still living in Malaysia, you all are so fortunate to still be living in such a beautiful, unique and blessed country.

I know I may be late, but Happy 69th Independence Day and Happy 63rd Malaysia Day! 💛💙❤️🤍🇲🇾

I strongly agree what is described about Malaysia -> Malaysia is Truly Asia! 💛💙❤️🤍🇲🇾 Hope to visit Malaysia soon ✈️🇲🇾
